text: Municipal Licensing and Standards Division will give a presentation on Update on Heat in Apartments.

The Tenant Issues Committee recommends to Executive Committee that: 1. City Council support, in principle, a maximum heat by-law of 26 degrees with an exemption process for buildings/landlords where there is undue hardship complying with the by-law, such exemption to provide a timeline for compliance with the by-law; and further request Municipal Licensing and Standards staff to consult with tenant and landlord groups on appropriate terms and timelines for implementation. 2. City Council direct the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards to develop a strategy to ensure that landlords do not exacerbate tenant discomfort through not turning on air-conditioning or keeping heat on, in the event of a warm weather period prior to June 2, 2018.
